assumptions.choice: Bollinger Bands (period=20, devfactor=2) used as the sole channel definition; Donchian Channel not implemented
assumptions.reason: Spec lists BB first and describes Donchian as an 'alternative'. Implementing one is sufficient and BB is the primary description.

assumptions.choice: Strategy runs on the 1H bars supplied by the harness without resampling
assumptions.reason: Spec calls for a 4H chart, but the harness provides 1H OHLCV bars. No resampling API is available within the strategy class; running on 1H is the closest literal reading.

assumptions.choice: Fixed risk of 1% of account equity per trade
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'e.g., 1% or 2%'; chose 1% as the lower bound of the illustrative range.

assumptions.choice: Stop order price set exactly at the lower Bollinger Band value recorded at signal time
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'below the lower band' without specifying a buffer. The lower band value itself is the most literal, minimal interpretation.

assumptions.topic: falling channel lookback and swing detection
assumptions.choice: Swing highs/lows are identified within the 20 bars immediately preceding the current bar (bars [-20] to [-1]) using a 1-bar local-extremum definition; any 3 consecutive identified swing highs decreasing and any 3 consecutive swing lows decreasing satisfies the condition
assumptions.reason: Spec requires '3 consecutive lower highs and lower lows' but states no lookback window or pivot definition. A 20-bar window matches the BB period; 1-bar neighbor comparison is the standard minimal local-extremum definition.

assumptions.choice: Current bar's close used as the entry price estimate when computing risk-per-share and position size at signal time; actual TP price is derived from the true fill price in notify_order
assumptions.reason: A market buy order fills at the next bar's open, which is unknown at signal time. Close is the standard proxy. TP is correctly anchored to the real fill price per the spec.

assumptions.choice: If the position is open but both SL and TP orders are absent (unexpected cancellation edge case), the position is closed at market on the next bar
assumptions.reason: Spec does not address this scenario. Closing prevents an indefinitely unprotected position.
